description: One-call agent-native Marrow loop. Returns passive status, decision brief, risk gate, relevant lessons, template suggestion, required proof pack, before-you-act instruction, and exact next action. Its runtime_authorization is the authoritative gate receipt; it returns decision_id only when runtime actually creates a decision. Reuse its server-created decision_id for outcome closure; use marrow_auto or marrow_think only when the completion contract requires decision creation. Use this before meaningful work when you want Marrow to guide the whole action in one call.

action.description: What the agent is about to do.

agentId.description: Optional agent_id filter. Defaults to the canonical fleet-bound agent identity.

period.description: Lookback period in days, default 7, max 90.

proof.description: Optional proof fields already collected, such as checks, rollback_target, smoke_result.

role.description: Agent role/playbook: deploy, audit, patch, review, or general.

sessionId.description: Optional session id. Defaults to MARROW_SESSION_ID.

surfaces.description: Surfaces to keep current, e.g. github, npm, docs, production, secrets.

type.description: Decision type, e.g. deploy, audit, patch, review.

name: marrow_agent_runtime
